description: This file defines the UserRoleRepository class responsible for managing user roles in the system. It provides methods to add roles to a user, remove all roles for a user, and find role names associated with a user ID. It uses JdbcTemplate for database operations within a Spring framework context.

classes.name: UserRoleRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing user roles in the database.

methods.name: addRoleToUser
methods.description: Adds a role to a user by inserting a record into the user_roles join table, handling conflicts to avoid duplicate entries.

methods.name: removeAllRolesForUser
methods.description: Removes all roles associated with a specific user by deleting relevant records from the user_roles table.

methods.name: findRoleNamesByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of role names associated with a given user ID by performing a join between roles and user_roles tables.
